module_summary: UART transmitter with phase-based serialization; strobe timing from external pacer module.

anchors.name: phase_r
anchors.why: 4-bit phase state machine: REST, LEAD, BODY, TAIL; controls entire transmission sequence.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Request to transmit; gates transition from REST to LEAD phase.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Ready output: asserted when in REST phase, derived from phase_r[0].

anchors.name: tx_data
anchors.why: 8-bit input data loaded into hold_reg when transitioning to LEAD.

anchors.name: tx_o
anchors.why: Serial output bit derived from phase and hold_reg LSB via line_level function.

anchors.name: hold_reg
anchors.why: 8-bit data holding register; loaded with tx_data and right-shifted during BODY phase.

anchors.name: nib
anchors.why: 3-bit nibble counter tracking shift progress; triggers phase transition when saturated.

anchors.name: strobe
anchors.why: Timing strobe from child pacer; gates phase transitions in LEAD, BODY, TAIL states.

anchors.name: at_rest
anchors.why: Phase decoder asserting REST state; parks pacer and drives busy status.

anchors.name: busy_o
anchors.why: Status output: asserted when not at rest; inverse of at_rest.

groups.name: FSM Controller
groups.description: 4-phase state machine controlling transmission sequence through LEAD, BODY, TAIL phases.

groups.name: Data Path
groups.description: Holding register for transmission data and nibble counter tracking shift progress.

groups.name: Timing Control
groups.description: Pacer strobe and rest-state decoder gating phase transitions and child module behavior.

groups.name: External Interface
groups.description: Handshake ports (tx_valid/tx_ready), data ports (tx_data/tx_o), and busy status output.
